default: Up ahead there should be a frog in a rain coat, make it up the platform and you shall find your way.
secret: I heard these birds love to steal things...they usually hide them in their nest
and they are sensitive to sounds.

default: I heard you’re after the moon flakes. Find my brother, he resides in the swamp regions, and he has what you need.
Past the frog that sleeps, you'll find a drone. It will guide you past the city gates.
secret: The bog reveals its secrets to those who do not run from the shaking ground. Look carefully at what lies ahead, not every lily is the same.

default: Brother sent you, didn't he? I knew someone brave would come. This is yours.
After the Moon Flakes huh?...I'll help you pass the city gates.
Past the sound of dripping water you will find what you seek.
secret: Something in this area has been slowly winning against the drones. Drip by drip.
